phrase.zh: 看不见的流动，也有自己的形状。
phrase.en: An invisible flow has a shape.

visual.zh: 顺着曲面转弯的细线与涡卷，表现空气或液体绕过物体的运动。线条是艺术安排，不是计算流体仿真的结果。
visual.en: Fine paths bend around a surface and curl into eddies, suggesting air or liquid flow. The lines are artistic, not the output of a fluid simulation.

background.zh: 流线用来表示流动在某一时刻的方向，流体速度在每一点都沿流线切向。NASA 用机翼和圆柱周围的流线帮助分析空气动力；真实流场会随形状和条件改变。
background.en: Streamlines represent flow direction at a given moment, with velocity tangent to the line at each point. NASA uses flow around an airfoil or cylinder to explain aerodynamics; real patterns depend on geometry and conditions.
